episode.seriesTitleJp: 第8話『今はまだ遥か幽かな光』
episode.seriesTitleEn: Episode 8 "A Light Still Far and Faint"
episode.descriptionJp: 活動は今年度限りと決めているEdel Note。来年度のセラスの所属先に心を配る泉のもとに、瑞河女子の後輩から「瑞河復活」の報が入り……。
episode.descriptionEn: Edel Note has decided their activities will last only through this school year. As Izumi worries about where Ceras will belong next year, a junior from Mizukawa brings news of "Mizukawa's revival"...

turns.textJp:
それに、泉が学校を休んでから、もう、5日。
一応『心配しないように』ってメッセージは来たけど……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Ginko
en_hasuko.text:
And it's already been five days since Izumi missed school.
She did send a message saying "Don't worry," but...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 긴코
ko_hasuko.text:
그리고, 이즈미가 학교를 쉰 지, 벌써, 5일.
일단 『걱정하지 말라』는 메시지는 왔지만…….

それに……泉がいなくなっちゃったら、
今、検査で実家に戻ってるセラスだって、
もしかしたら来年、瑞河に……。

Ceras, who's back home for tests right now,
might go to Mizukawa next year...

어쩌면 내년에, 미즈카와로…….

she is properly going at her own pace. She looked happy with her new companions.

or any other negative reason this time.

誰かに見出してもらうだけじゃ、駄目だと気づいたんだ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Izumi
en_hasuko.text:
I want to find for myself the light each of you carries in your heart.
I realized it is not enough to have someone else find it for me.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 이즈미

너희 한 사람 한 사람이 가슴에 품은 빛을, 나도 나 자신으로 찾고 싶어.
누군가에게 발견되는 것만으로는, 안 된다는 걸 깨달았어.

At times, I may run into walls. I may stumble again and again.
Perhaps this decision is not a wise choice.

as I try to move forward earnestly and stubbornly.

en_hasuko.speaker: Izumi
en_hasuko.text:
Like Sayaka-senpai once did. Like Kaho-senpai, who raised up an outrageous dream.
Like Rurino-senpai, who acted believing she could change.
